title: Operate preventive and detective control families: decision comparison 1
teachingQuestion: Where should each boundary control operate and how does it fail safely?
focalInsight: Each row distinguishes purpose, selection, failure, and response.
caption: Compare meaning, decision conditions, and failures. These concise distinctions are paired with the worked examples in the teaching unit.
altSummary: Each row distinguishes purpose, selection, failure, and response.
textFallback:
firewall: Firewall: policy filters flow. Decision: decide boundary/rules/default.. Failure/example: management bypass.
next generation firewall: NGFW: adds app/identity/content context. Decision: decide decrypt/inspect limits.. Failure/example: encrypted blind spot.
web application firewall: WAF: web request protection. Decision: decide app coverage/tuning.. Failure/example: API bypass.
ids: IDS: detects only. Decision: decide response owner.. Failure/example: alert ignored.
ips: IPS: blocks. Decision: decide fail-open/closed.. Failure/example: outage or bypass.
allowlist: Allowlist: permit known set. Decision: decide maintenance/exception.. Failure/example: needed update blocked.
denylist: Denylist: block known set. Decision: decide currency/coverage.. Failure/example: unknown threat allowed.
third party security service: Third-party service: outsourced control. Decision: decide data/access/SLA/exit.. Failure/example: provider outage.
sandbox: Sandbox: isolate untrusted execution. Decision: decide escape/evasion limits.. Failure/example: sample reaches production.
